config.interaction_justification: Interactions are set to 0 before any test evaluation so EBM remains an additive per-original-feature reference. They are not added to improve test scores.
config.imbalance_strategy: none (EBM 0.7.8 has no class_weight argument; labels are used as observed)
config.input_representation: Stage 4A train-only (or train+val) imputers applied to the original 9 columns; one-hot expansion is not used because it would destroy EBM additive structure and exceed practical memory on 1023 dense dummy columns.
